# Remove the invalid test file
Remove-Item "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\config\queue\test-clip.json" -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Create a clean, properly formatted JSON test file
$testPayload = '{"timestamp": "2026-10-10 18:18:00", "source": "manual-test", "content": "Aroha matrix pipeline test"}'
$testPayload | Out-File -FilePath "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\config\queue\test-clip.json" -Encoding utf8

# Run the queue processor in the foreground to verify it processes successfully
node "$HOME\aroha-matrix\auto-ha\src\queue_processor.js"
